title: Unctuous Australian Cheese Lasagna
description: A rich and satisfying lacto-vegetarian dish featuring a unique combination of peanut butter and long-fermentation dough, perfect for a comforting meal. This garlicky, cheese-pull lasagna is a great hangover cure.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the long-fermentation dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Spread a layer of peanut butter on the dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle shredded mozzarella cheese and grated parmesan cheese over the peanut butter layer.
Spread a layer of tomato sauce over the cheese layer.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of mozzarella cheese on top.
Drizzle olive oil over the top layer of cheese and sprinkle with salt and black pepper.
Place the lasagna in a donabe and bake for 45 minutes.
Remove the lasagna from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
